name: inner_value
query:
SELECT (
    SELECT "__pgdbg_join"."label"
    FROM "join_checks"."child" AS "__pgdbg_row"
    INNER JOIN "join_checks"."parent" AS "__pgdbg_join"
        ON "__pgdbg_row"."tenant" = "__pgdbg_join"."tenant" AND "__pgdbg_row"."parent_key" = "__pgdbg_join"."key"
    WHERE "__pgdbg_row"."id" = $1
)
